reasons: All three requested gates fail the frozen inclusion-scale review and remain execution- and promotion-ineligible.

The exact demand-revision and production-vintage hypothesis cannot be reconstructed from the retained historical Summer inputs, whose legacy hours-0 temperature snapshot also predates the corrected four-sample local-day contract.
All checked history was visible during development, and the full sensitivity family tests multiple related treatments.
The descriptive selection-prefix leader has a full-16-family adjusted block-10 p-value of 0.40126.
The descriptive selection-prefix leader loses 2.417878 incremental daily-sum percentage points in report-only 2025.
Only 6 price/fade candidates improve both the through-2024 prefix and report-only 2025, and each changes at most 11 forecast episodes.
Both requested price gates fail timing specificity: their one-extra-session-lag controls improve the selection prefix by 7.667159 and 2.389298 points, more than the unlagged gates.

The complete historical regime contains only 16 extreme-heat forecast episodes; the requested gates change 9 to 11 forecast episodes and none has the 15 independent interventions used as the minimum prospective Summer scale reference.
EIA publication timing is causal, but current-vintage storage values cannot exclude later historical revisions.
The supplied July 15-24, 2026 loss begins after the checked comparator ends and is not backfilled into the audit.
The exact fresh lead-8-to-lead-7 revision idea remains isolated in the prospective spatial-demand-revision shadow.

directlyTested: flat, quarter-size, and half-size extreme-heat exposure
completed issue-session and prior-three-session NG=F price gates
small short fades only when both storage and issue-price state contradict the long
notHistoricallyTestable: exact multi-model lead-8-to-lead-7 Summer demand revisions
point-in-time production forecasts or production surprises
a structural residual estimating what the futures curve had already priced

july2026Incident.reason: Versioned UNG/VOO/QQQM outcomes and selected all-year rows end before the incident; no later outcome is synthesized or backfilled.

signalAndTimingContract.selectedRows: only selected summer-heat-long rows can be changed; Winter, Summer reversion, and index-fallback rows remain unchanged
signalAndTimingContract.extremeDefinition: aggregate coolingDemandAnomalyF must meet the candidate threshold and coolingDemandExtremeCount must contain at least the candidate count; that retained count was computed once at the fixed 8F per-location cooling-demand threshold
signalAndTimingContract.freshnessProxy: zero-based session age within the exact selected issueDate and targetDate heat episode
signalAndTimingContract.storage: latest EIA report released by 09:30 New York on each held session, strictly below the mean of the same Jan-1-anchored seasonal week in the five prior years
signalAndTimingContract.issuePrice: close-to-close return for an exact authoritative issueDate session; weekend and holiday issues have no issue-session observation and the focal gate fails closed
signalAndTimingContract.priorPrice: three compounded authoritative completed NG=F sessions ending with the latest session on or before issueDate; weekend and holiday issues therefore use a preceding-session anticipatory-pricing window
signalAndTimingContract.authoritativePriceSessions: the complete selected VOO/QQQM execution-session grid; duplicate or missing NG=F closes invalidate the observation
signalAndTimingContract.focalMissingObservationPolicy: fail closed to the index basket for the three requested full-veto gates
signalAndTimingContract.productionVintageStatus: unavailable historically; production gates are not represented by a synthetic or revised series
signalAndTimingContract.exactForecastRevisionStatus: unavailable in the retained historical Summer calendar; lead-8-to-lead-7 demand revision remains prospective-only

storage.valueVintagePolicy: Release timing is historical-calendar-causal, but values come from the current checked-in EIA series; release-vintage revisions are not excluded.
